entry.name: Tower Shield
entry.description: A wall of iron. Superb protection, but heavy and slow to raise.
entry.special_note: Tank wall: the best armor in the game (mitigation 16), but heavy (burden 3, needs STR 15) and paired with the weakest sword; the warrior gives up offense and mobility for it.

entry.name: Glass Wand
entry.description: A brittle crystal wand that hums with raw power.
entry.special_note: Glass cannon: very high ranged power (30 at range 3, needs INT 14) and no protection at all; best for a mage kept behind a tank.
